question: What specific yogic technique involving breath at the palate is prescribed to counteract decay?
premises: A location at the root of tongue and palate is specified.
The breath is to be drawn in.
The action must be done slowly.
inference: One should slowly draw in the breath at the root of the tongue and palate.
plain_english: Placing attention at the root of the tongue and palate, one should slowly drink in the breath.
